reviews.comment: Dr. Barna makes this class about as easy as it can be. I took the summer section, and it was 4 tests worth 25 points each, with 5 points of extra credit being offered if you complete all the homework before the class is over. He is very clear about the kinds of questions you should expect on exams and does not require you to read the textbook.

Made 311 pretty doable. He is very fair, chill, and likes teaching law. Textbook isn't a mandatory read but I used it to prepare for exams (topics are short paragraphs 1-2). His slides are what he tests on so if he didn't mention it in class then don't need to look further. 4 exams all multiple choice-has bonus questions. 5% extra on overall grade.
Professor Barna tells great stories that connect directly to test questions. I took this class in the summer. Strongly recommend reading the chapters and doing the practice at the end for practice.

COMM 307. This is the EASIEST CLASS I have ever taken at TAMU. All you have to do is show up to class, take notes to help you with studying for the exam, and take the exams. Exams are multiple choice, 30-50 questions, 1-2 bonus questions AND Mr. Barna tells you exactly what is going to be on the exam. No homework/quizzes/attendance/readings.

Took for JOUR 301. Only grades are tests but he will tell you what you need to know for the test and they are not too difficult. Lectures can be very boring but he does not take attendance. There is extra credit available and I learned a lot in the class.
Love this guy! Only graded by 4 tests so studying is important. A little bit of extra credit is available. Very sweet guy, if you show him respect he will show the same in return!

Lectures are probably the least engaging ones I've had in my entire educational career. Puts up the same powerpoint that he posts on Canvas for all his students and just reads off of it. The powerpoints are just strings of text, no pictures, nothing to make it engaging. Every person I know who had a different professor for this class got an A.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Course is based on 4 exams which aren't that bad if you study a couple of weeks out and attend the review sessions. There is not a lot of practice problems available though, which can make it hard to study. need to really show up to class considering all the slides are online, attendance isn't mandatory, and the lectures are unbearably boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Mgmt 311 gets a lot of hype for being super difficult. In Barna's sections I don't believe that's the case. You do not have to go to class as long as you read the textbook in detail and focus on the cases mentioned in the book - if you can do this you can easily do well on the exams. Lectures are quite long and boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I'll be honest, I went to two classes the whole semester.  The class is very manageable as long as you study effectively and don't cram.  If you go to class you will most likely finish with an A.  Just don't be a lazy pos like me and you're chillin', Barna is solid prof fs.
Tests were mostly based off of memorization, so if you study you will be fine. Provided extra credit point opportunities that could add a max of 5 points to your final grade.

I really loved this class. After the first test you'll have a pretty good idea of what the rest will look like, and I had great success just going over the slides and taking notes of the extra things he mentioned. Never opened the book once. Lecture can be dull, but he gives good info for exams, practice problems, and is funny.

Study his slides and you should at least get a B on the exams. Read the book and Study slides for a pretty easy A. Also offers extra credit for doing the mindsmarts (Which are easy). Everyone overhyped 311 I personally really enjoyed it and thought it wasn't hard at all. I highly recommend Barna.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Grade based on 4 tests and 5 extra credit points. Briefly goes over topics during lecture but you have to read the textbook and make sure you have a deep understand the topics (tbh class isn't that important). His exams are much easier than other profs and the extra credit is a BIG help. If you are someone who is willing study hard you will do well
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Personally, I did not like Barna's teaching style and learned much better by just skipping class and reading the textbook. The only grades are tests and they are much harder than any of the "review" questions he shows in class. They are much more application based than just information and take a deep understanding of the concepts to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is only 4 exams and up to 5 points worth of extra credit. DO NOT take this class if you are not a good test taker, if you are this class is perfect for you. The lectures, exam review sessions, and notes are all very helpful if you take advantage of it.

Let me start off by saying he is a very nice guy and super helpful. However, in my opinion, he is not good at teaching. All he does is read off slides and go into detail on things that are unimportant. He doesn't really teach how to apply the concepts but that is pretty much all he tests on. He is not engaging, be prepared to read.

I took him for COMM 307 - law and policy. Extremely boring lectures with slides as long as a book. He just reads right through them. I still go to class because he'll add some info. There are 4 tests and that's your grade so you really have to know the info. I like him, really nice guy, really wants people to ask questions.
This class was so chill like just study the powerpoints & practice those extra credit cengage homework problems. Professor Barna takes questions in class so if you're confused just ask him directly.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors in Mays. The lecture and exams are difficult but Dr Barna is always there to help. Read the textbook especially the example cases, do quizlet, come to his office hour if you feel confused, then A is there!!!!!

He is amazing. If you communicate with him then he will go out of his way to do office hours with you. I will say, this class is challenging but absolutely rewarding. DO NOT MISS CLASS. READ THE TEXTBOOK. I did study a lot for his exams but once I had my study skills down it was not too hard. If you care, he will too. Very approachable.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a nice guy, but the material can be pretty boring. There is a textbook, but his slides have pretty much everything you need to know for the exams on them. 4 exams each worth 25% of your grade. Extra credit is super easy and worth 10% (a whole letter grade) on top of your grade. Study the practice questions and slides and you'll do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Grade depends on 4 exams and he gives an extra credit assignment worth an extra 10%. Exams aren't bad if you outline the readings and make quizlets to study. He's a great professor, he obviously wants students to succeed and comes off as passionate about the course material.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Barna is first off, very knowledgeable on what he's teaching and is available and will answer all your questions. However, his lectures to me are very boring and drawn out. I ended up just reading the textbook mostly which was helpful. A downgrade to this class is it is straight exams, so make sure you study and focus on those.
Prof Barna rocks!! The classes are lecture heavy and he goes over slides over each chapter, but he will answer any questions you have and makes a difficult course bearable. Wants you to succeed.
